author: Tyler F Martin
title: Looking for artist for 15-page horror fan comic pitch
content:
Hey guys! Looking for an artist to collab on a fan comic to be used as a pitch! 15 pages! 

When CIA agent John Ruiz is recruited into The Horrormen, he discovers a classified program that captures legendary monsters and weaponizes their darkest desires. Chucky, Jason Voorhees, Freddy Krueger, Samara, and Lubden are forced into missions against threats too horrific for conventional forces.

But controlling monsters is impossible.

To stop Hell from unleashing… they’ve got to unleash hell.
